row_unit: One future, policy, checkpoint and experimental variant. Four checkpoint rows can describe one normal model evaluation.
units: USD unless a field explicitly says Bitcoin, shares, percentage points or native currency. Returns and changes are fractions, not percentages.

columns.future_id: Stable identifier in the corresponding inputs/futures_PHASE.json file.
columns.phase: main, challenge, historical, boundary or stress. Sensitivities reuse main future identifiers.
columns.family: Stylized, block-resampled or complete historical Bitcoin price shape.
columns.policy: Policy identifier. Exact rules are in model.py and inputs/revised_policies.json.
columns.horizon: Checkpoint date. Core 2031-06-30 and long 2033-06-30 closure tails end one year later.
columns.variant: normal, a core or long closure variant, or a named sensitivity.
columns.payments: Every conditional dated cash payment through this checkpoint was completed.
columns.funded: Payments completed and the reserve floor was respected at every corporate event from opening through the checkpoint.
columns.reserve_compliant: Reserve condition on all processed snapshots. A stopped path may satisfy this condition and still fail funded.
columns.mapping_defined: The conditional common quote is defined on all computed daily marks through the last processed date. For stopped paths this is not a claim about the unprocessed remainder.
columns.nominal_value: Funded and a defined completed-path common return of at least zero, with 1e-12 ratio tolerance.
columns.annual_5pct: Funded and a defined common return meeting the 5 percent annual compounded hurdle over actual days divided by 365.25, with 1e-12 tolerance.
columns.bitcoin_per_share: Funded and final Bitcoin per basic common share at least its opening value, with 1e-12 ratio tolerance.
columns.common_return: Conditional endpoint quote divided by opening quote minus one. Missing for an incomplete or unmapped path; it is not assigned a zero recovery value.
columns.bitcoin_per_share_change: Endpoint Bitcoin per basic share divided by opening Bitcoin per basic share minus one; missing for incomplete paths.
columns.first_stop_date: First unsupported payment date when it is at or before this checkpoint. A reserve-only failure need not stop the ledger.
columns.cash_gap_usd: Cash shortfall at the first payment stop; zero when there is no applicable stop.
columns.permission_gap_usd: Maximum of the reserve-use authorization gap and the general-purpose Bitcoin funding gap at the first stop. Components can overlap, so they are not added.
columns.minimum_reserve_margin_usd: Smallest designated reserve minus required floor across processed corporate snapshots, including opening.
columns.daily_common_drawdown: Minimum daily conditional quote divided by its running maximum minus one. For stopped paths this describes only the processed prefix. Missing if the mapping is undefined.
columns.btc_price_return: Exogenous Bitcoin price change at the stated checkpoint even if the corporate ledger stopped earlier.
columns.common_gross_usd: Cumulative settled gross common issuance through the last processed date at or before the checkpoint.
columns.strc_gross_usd: Cumulative settled gross STRC issuance; shares and stated principal reflect actual execution price.
columns.bitcoin_sold: Cumulative Bitcoin units sold for funding through the processed prefix.
columns.bitcoin_purchased: Cumulative Bitcoin units purchased through the processed prefix.
columns.preferred_cash_paid_usd: All settled preferred cash dividends, converted at payment-date FX. Includes original shares and generated new STRC entitlements.
columns.annual_preferred_runrate_usd: Annualized distributions on all ending preferred principal at current rates and FX. Available for completed paths even if reserves previously breached.
columns.remaining_principal_usd: Ending debt principal for a completed path; all retained debt is USD. Preferred principal is excluded.
columns.final_bitcoin: Ending Bitcoin units for a completed path.
columns.final_liquid_usd: Ending unrestricted cash plus Treasuries for a completed path. Reserve designation is a use restriction within this pool, not another asset.
columns.common_share_growth: Ending basic common shares divided by opening shares minus one for a completed path.
columns.config_sha256: SHA256 of the full canonical JSON configuration supplied to the derivative engine.
columns.ledger_entries: Number of atomic journal entries through the processed prefix at this checkpoint.
columns.ledger_prefixes_reconciled: True only after the engine independently reconstructs every atomic journal prefix from its opening and deltas.
columns.independent_checks: Number of additional numerical stock-flow and entitlement comparisons in the evaluation; logical authority and T+1 checks are additional.
columns.max_stock_flow_difference: Largest absolute numerical difference in the additional stock-flow and entitlement comparisons; comparisons use the recorded relative and absolute tolerances.

discovery_features: Exogenous trajectory summaries only. No policy cash balance, issuance quantity, stop date or realized policy outcome is used as a PRIM input. Whole-future descriptors are explanatory and are not manager information.

prim_statistics.density: Failures inside the selected region divided by all cases inside it.
prim_statistics.coverage: Failures inside the selected region divided by all failures in the evaluated set.
prim_statistics.mass: All cases inside the region divided by the evaluated set size.
prim_statistics.inside: Unweighted supporting case count. It is not an effective independent sample size.
prim_statistics.union: Union of selected boxes. Overlap is counted once.

interpretation: All frequencies and quantiles refer to the stated design and conditioning set. No occurrence probabilities, post-failure market values or causal identification are inferred.
